_comment: Advisor findings we keep on purpose. triage.mjs and the weekly GitHub check ignore these. object is schema.name (or the metadata entity), or * for every object of that rule. env is prod or staging; leave it out for both. Add an entry only with a reason the user agreed to.

accepted.reason: INFO. RLS on with no policy means only the service role can read or write, which is how every app reaches these tables (createAdminClient).
pg_net does not support ALTER EXTENSION SET SCHEMA; moving it means drop and recreate, which breaks the pg_cron jobs that call it.
Trigram indexes and search functions reference public operator classes. Moving the extension has risk and no security gain.
apps/app /api/auth/check-username calls it with the anon client. It only says whether a username is taken.
apps/app /api/auth/check-username calls it with the anon client. It only suggests free usernames.
Nobody signs in with Supabase Auth passwords. Students use Firebase, staff use Microsoft Entra.
